sentences.text: Kenneth Arnold `` Kenny '' Chesney -LRB- born March 26 , 1968 -RRB- is an American country music singer , songwriter and record producer .	country music	country music
He has recorded 20 albums , 14 of which have been certified Gold or higher by the RIAA .	RIAA	Recording Industry Association of America

He has also produced more than 40 top 10 singles on the U.S. Billboard Hot Country Songs and Country Airplay charts , 29 of which have reached number one on the charts .	Country	Country music	Billboard	Billboard Hot 100	Hot Country Songs	Hot Country Songs	Country Airplay	Country Airplay

Most of these have also charted high within the top 40 of the Billboard Hot 100 chart , making him one of the few successful crossover country artists .	Billboard	Billboard Hot 100	Hot 100	Billboard Hot 100
He has sold over 30 million albums worldwide .
Chesney co-directed and produced a film for ESPN entitled The Boys of Fall .

He has received six Academy of Country Music awards -LRB- including four consecutive Entertainer of the Year awards from 2005 to 2008 -RRB- , as well as six awards from the Country Music Association .	Country	Country music
He is one of the most popular touring acts in country music , regularly selling out the venues in which he performs .	country music	country music
His 2007 Flip-Flop Summer Tour was the highest-grossing country road trip of the year .
The Country Music Association honored Chesney with the Entertainer of the Year award in 2004 , 2006 , 2007 , and 2008 .	Country	Country music

Other notable awards he received include the Academy of Country Music 's 1997 New Male Vocalist of the Year , 2002 Top Male Vocalist of the Year , and the Triple Crown Award in 2005 .	Country	Country music
